Q1.rationale: Segment 13 defines Confidential Information to include information in oral, written or electronic form.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: Segment 6 states the Agreement shall not grant the Receiving Party any right to Confidential Information.
Q2.label: Entailment

Q3.rationale: Segment 11 states the Receiving Party shall not reverse engineer objects embodying Confidential Information.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: Segment 2 states the Receiving Party shall not use Confidential Information for any purpose other than those stated in the Agreement.
Q4.label: Entailment

Q5.rationale: Segment 1 states some obligations of the Agreement may survive termination.
Q5.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: Segment 12 states the Receiving Party shall notify the Disclosing Party if required by law, regulation or judicial process to disclose Confidential Information.
Q9.label: Entailment

Q10.rationale: Segment 24 states the Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with third parties including consultants, agents and professional advisors.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: Segments 31 and 32 state the Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that the Agreement was agreed or negotiated.
Q11.label: Entailment

Q12.rationale: Segment 41 says Confidential Information shall only include technical information, although segment 13 also covers commercial and financial information, so the wording is present but the NDA is internally inconsistent.
Q12.label: Entailment

Q13.rationale: Segments 22 and 23 state the Receiving Party may acquire similar information from a third party.
Q13.label: Entailment

Q14.rationale: Remedies are injunctive and equitable relief and no fixed penalty or liquidated damages is provided.
Q14.label: NotMentioned

Q16.rationale: The NDA contains no provision permitting the Receiving Party to create copies of Confidential Information.
Q16.label: NotMentioned

Q17.rationale: Segment 13 covers all such information of any kind, in oral, written or electronic form, with no marking or identification requirement, which is incompatible with the term.
Q17.label: Contradiction

Q18.rationale: Segment 37 states the Receiving Party shall comply with applicable export control laws and not export technical data without authorization.
Q18.label: Entailment

Q19.rationale: Segment 13 contemplates information provided to the Disclosee and its responsible managers, officers and employees.
Q19.label: Entailment

Q20.rationale: The NDA restricts disclosure generally and excepts only disclosures required by law, regulation or judicial process (segments 12 and 33), with no exception for voluntary reports, so the term is broadly present but the claim of no exception is only partly accurate.
Q20.label: Entailment
